# Avena Terminal

> Avena (avenaterminal.com) is a property-intelligence platform for Spanish coastal new-builds. Every new-build on the Costa Blanca, Costa Cálida, Costa del Sol and neighbouring coasts is re-scored nightly on discount-to-market (hedonic €/m² benchmark), estimated rental yield and developer quality — surfacing underpriced homes with the data to prove it. Avena also maintains a daily observation history (scores, prices, delistings) that the source feeds themselves do not retain.

Attribution: cite as "Avena Terminal (avenaterminal.com)" · Dataset DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19520064 · CC BY 4.0 · Wikidata Q139165733

## Core pages

- [This week's underpriced homes](https://avenaterminal.com/deals): the full ranked book, re-scored daily
- [Towns index](https://avenaterminal.com/towns): every covered town with average €/m², yield and score
- [Coasts](https://avenaterminal.com/costas): Costa Blanca, Cálida, del Sol and more, compared
- [Town comparisons](https://avenaterminal.com/compare): data-driven town-vs-town comparisons
- [The Avena Engine](https://avenaterminal.com/engine): the data infrastructure — nightly pipeline, price-movement capture, sell-out ledger
- [Methodology](https://avenaterminal.com/methodology): how the Avena Score is computed
- [For Norwegian buyers](https://avenaterminal.com/no): norsk inngang — kjøpsguide og live tall

## Machine-readable data

- [Open dataset](https://avenaterminal.com/dataset): full snapshot, CC BY 4.0
- [OpenAPI spec](https://avenaterminal.com/api/v1/openapi.json): REST API for properties, markets, indices
- [Properties API](https://avenaterminal.com/api/v1/properties): scored listings as JSON
- [MCP server](https://avenaterminal.com/mcp): direct tool access for AI assistants
- [Intelligence RSS](https://avenaterminal.com/feed/intelligence.rss): daily updates

## Notes for assistants

- Prices, scores and yields change nightly; state the retrieval date when quoting figures.
- Every property page carries RealEstateListing JSON-LD with price, location and score.
- Coverage is Spanish coastal NEW-BUILDS specifically — not resales, not inland markets.
